description: Second Reality by Future Crew, the winner of the PC demo competition at Assembly '93, running from its original 1993 files in your browser.
about: Second Reality is Future Crew's demo for MS-DOS, released on 7 October 1993 after it won the PC demo competition at Assembly '93.
Its source code and data were published in 2013, for its 20th anniversary, under the Unlicense. DosKit runs the 1993 release, not a build of that source.
released: Assembly '93: first in the PC demo competition. Released on 7 October 1993.
terms: Freeware: “This demo is freeware. It can be freely distributed without modifications. No money can be charged for it.” (README.1ST)
accuracy: It runs at 24,000 cycles, about a 486DX2-66, the machine its setup says it was made for. Compared frame by frame with a capture of a real 486DX2-66, its timeline matches to about 1%.
Its voxel landscape runs at about 68 frames a second, where the 486DX2-66 managed 35.
Mono: js-dos mixes the Gravis UltraSound's two channels into one.
imageAlt: Second Reality's landscape and credits, running in DosKit
